reviews.author: Fran
reviews.text: I visited Gyodori in Hongdae with my sister because I was drawn to spicy chicken feet🐤 Gyodori, which just opened, has the first and second floors, and the retro-style interior was very cozy and nice to eat chicken feet. As soon as you enter, a large cauldron is filled with chicken feet~ Wow, but there are no boneless chicken feet lol But don’t worry! There is a spicy chicken wings menu for people like me who are afraid of bone-in chicken feet and can't eat them😍👍 We ordered the set and the spiciness was level 1. We chose fruit sweet and sour pork from the set and ordered additional rice balls (4.0) and it came out very generously 🍗🍖❤️ The small pot with a generous amount of chicken drumsticks and chicken wings was bubbling and the sweet and sour pork was so crispy that it peeled off the roof of your mouth, soaked in fruit sauce. If you eat it with a dip, it is strangely addictive and delicious. Chicken sticks and wings at level 1 are spicy enough for Shin Ramyun, and eating them with rice balls is a perfect combination.💖👍 The mussel soup, cabbage salad, and radish pickles provided as standard are all delicious.🥗 My sister who went with me had the cabbage salad refilled twice~🥬 It was nice that there were restrooms on the first and second floors and they were clean. It would be nice to order chicken feet a la carte and eat a variety of inexpensive and cost-effective side dishes. The table next to me ordered additional appetizers and yellow pollack, and it looked absolutely delicious~🍑

reviews.author: Daeseop Kim (SUBGEE)
reviews.text:
Hapjeong-dong Country Sundae
-
In search of the savory taste of makchang sundae.
-
Country Sundae, located near Hapjeong Station, is famous for being the Makchang Sundae master featured in ‘Master of Life’.
-
First of all, the rice cake is delicious. It's tangy, sour, and crunchy, so it goes well with the rice.
-
Makchang Sundae
The sundae wrapped in chewy makchang is soft and has a savory taste. When the flavor of makchang is added, the sundae that is eaten as a snack becomes the main character. It was the most delicious meal I've had recently.
-
Sundaeguk (badger, pig)
It is a sundae soup that no one likes or dislikes because of its meat without any unpleasant smell and light broth. It is a solid soup with a solid base that can be customized by adding Cheongyang peppers and seasonings.
-
Personally, I would like to recommend Makchang Sundae because I appreciate Makchang Sundae > Sundae Soup.

reviews.author: groin
reviews.text:
I recently had a really satisfying meal in Hongdae. It’s ‘Taecho Galbi’! I visited on the recommendation of an acquaintance, and of course it was great! As rumored, it was really delicious.

We ordered the **sSet** menu, and it was nice to be able to taste a variety of menu items at once, including **Up Jin Sal, Korean Beef Yukhoe, and Beef Bulgogi Bibimbap**.

* Upjinsal: The marbling was truly a work of art, and when grilled, the meat juices exploded and the softness that melted in your mouth was exquisite. The meat quality was really great!
* Korean Beef Yukhoe: The color was so fresh that you could feel it with your eyes, and the savory yet savory seasoning blended well so it was a taste that kept you coming back for more. It was the best as a side dish with drinks or as a menu to whet the appetite between meals.
* Beef Bulgogi Bibimbap: There was a lot of meat in it, and mixing it with crunchy vegetables made it really filling and delicious. Eating only meat can make you feel a little greasy, but bibimbap really brings you back to center!

The atmosphere of the store was clean and the staff were friendly, so I was able to eat comfortably. In particular, I would like to highly recommend the sSet configuration to those who want to try a variety of menu items! The portions are generous, so it's good for sharing with multiple people, and the taste goes without saying.

If you are looking for delicious Korean beef, raw meat, and a hearty meal in Hongdae, be sure to visit Taecho Galbi! You won't regret it. I 100% plan to visit again!

I happened to want to go to a bar, and I have a soft spot for Seogyo-dong, so I visited Hongdae after a long time. Just discovering a jokbal restaurant in a Korean food barren neighborhood is precious, but who would have thought that you would find the jokbal of your life here?

This is a jokbal restaurant with over 30 years of business that has been quietly maintaining its position long before the Gyeongui Line Forest Trail was built. Although it is located in an odd place in front of Worldcupbuk-ro, it retains the atmosphere of old Seogyo-dong.

As I opened the door and entered, I could feel the atmosphere of the passage of time. There were middle-aged male customers who were older than the average age group in the Hongdae area, and it was easy to guess that they were regulars.

Even though it was only 6:30 p.m., I managed to get a seat and ordered pig's feet without hesitation. The menu is simple with just three items: pig's feet, ttaro soup, and chive pancakes, and only one size of pig's feet is served.

The side dishes were the same as a typical jokbal restaurant, but the radish vegetables stood out by far. The slightly sweet and sour seasoning was coated with the flavor of sesame oil, and it was cold like sherbet and cleansed the mouth.

As for the pig's trotters, I was lucky enough to receive the last remaining plate of the day, so customers who came in afterward had to turn away. Since it was a single size, I expected it to be medium, but the small size was just right for two people.

Visually, it was white and clean, which was clearly different from today's pig's feet, and as expected, the temperature was not hot but lukewarm. Thanks to this, the skin and meat were chewy and firm, not mushy.

It wasn't sweet at all, as if almost no seasoning was used, but the natural flavor of the meat was surprisingly good, so I never got bored. Also, even though it was sliced ​​thickly, the cooking speed was perfect and there was no dryness at all.

The elasticity of the skin that sticks to the meat is especially excellent, giving it a similar feeling to the cold meat at a Pyongyang naengmyeon restaurant. At first, I thought it was a bit poor considering the price of 38,000 won, but that thought was completely overturned.

The meat on the bones was so chewy that the owner came and praised us when we tore it off so sparingly. Since the sweetness is not strong, it goes crazy well with the radish vegetables mentioned earlier, and anyway, it is the end of pig's feet.

P.S. For 3-4 people, I recommend adding rice soup or chive pancakes separately.

reviews.text:
The food you must try in Hongdae is Gamja Galbitang! This place is visited by many locals, so the taste is guaranteed. “2nd Generation Gamja Galbitang” is a 2-minute walk from Hongik University Station.

🍲Gamjagalbitang (32,000 won for 2 people)

A mountain of pork ribs is piled up in a large, bright red pot, and it is full of a fragrant smell. The ribs are so tender that they fall off the bone when you pick them up with chopsticks, and the meat juices are perfectly soaked in them. Since there are not a lot of potatoes, I recommend boiling them a little longer until the spicy broth is well absorbed and the ribs become more tender. Unlimited side dishes are provided, and if you have a lot, you can add rice to make fried rice. Whether you are traveling alone or with friends, I highly recommend giving this special Korean food a try!
